Post:
Player Impressions:
Hoyos - game up HUGE late to keep this game for atlanat
Báez - defended well, getting much better as a winger.  was difficult to defend against
Alonso - his best work was in keeping the backline organized.  
Díaz - tremendous night.  several key blocks
Jacob - came off early.  Edwards far outshined him
Muyumba - playing a bit rough in the first half.  calmed down in the 2nd.  was getting a bit outplayed
Amaro - reads the game well, makes sudden runs up the left, right, and middle
Almirón - total defensive play in the 2nd half.  Read long passes, made runs.  Distributed well.  Enjoyed his play
Miranchuk - His distribution was very good tonight.  plays better coming central
Galoppo - an amzing first half.  Ran out of gas quickly in the 2nd and disappeared.  He completely raised the bar in midfield.  When he's fit, he'll be a handfull.
Embolo - his best plays were all hold-up.  Keeping the ball for Atlanta possession, or other players.  As a striker, a poor performance.  Worrying as it almost looks like he's losing confidence.  He needs to score in the next game.

subs:
Edwards - superb play on the right.  He and Velde battled all game.  Has a bit too physical, but looked intentional.  He was announcing his presense with authority, to quote Bull Durham
Sanchez - quiet performance.  Had one really good block at the end.  This was not his game.  It was all down to Atlanta defending by the time he came on
Mihaj - a great option as a sub.  He was aggressive, and read balls well.  He picked up for a tiring Díaz when it was needed
Fortune - like Sanchez, a quiet performance.  With Atlanta doing more defending, it was probably better to bring on Gill.  But Fortune also needs fitness.



Hernández - he had a good game, marking Miggy on the right.
